name: 侠客新传98书剑
group_note: 「侠客新传」v0.1b, MudOS v22pre11, Xkxz MUD Wizard Group 2000-2001, maintained by jjgod. WASM pass fixed 5 distinct bugs: (1) the same eventd.lpc off-by-one already fixed on wdxtym: event_name = map_array(event_name, (: $1[0..<3] :)) only stripped 2 characters trying to remove the 4-character '.lpc' suffix ('emei.lpc' -> 'emei.l'), breaking collect_all_event()'s call_other() to every event file -- fixed to [0..<5]. (2) §8.1-class check_legal_name()/is_chinese() GBK-byte-range bugs in adm/simul_efun/chinese.lpc (checked only the first 2 raw bytes against a fixed byte range, always failing under UTF8 codepoint indexing) and adm/daemons/logind.lpc's own length bound (min 2 / max passed as 8, meant to be min 1 / max 4 per the registration prompt text '名字的长度不能大于四个汉字') -- rewrote is_chinese() to a per-codepoint loop and fixed both the length bound and the check_legal_name(arg, 8) call site to 4. (3) A systemic is_killing(object) vs is_killing(string) type mismatch across 18 files (feature/attack.lpc declares is_killing(string id), but many call sites across kungfu skills and city NPCs passed the object directly: is_killing(me)/is_killing(who)/is_killing(ob)/is_killing(ob[i])) -- the exact same bug class already fixed on sjecl/sje earlier in this pass, here far more widespread; fixed every active call site to pass ->query('id') (2 already-commented-out call sites in haotian-zhang/ju.lpc and quanzhen-jianfa/ding.lpc left untouched, since they're dead code). (4)+(5) §7.41-class corrupted-save bugs: adm/daemons/emoted.lpc's create() called restore() unguarded on a genuinely corrupted emote.o ('Illegal mapping format'), and adm/daemons/newsd.lpc's create() had the identical unguarded restore() on a corrupted dbase save -- both wrapped in catch() so the exception no longer aborts create() before reaching (or in emoted's case, entirely skips) the empty-mapping fallback; confirmed via the driver's own error trace that both are now caught locally (CATCH() frame inside the daemon's own create()) rather than propagating to a distant outer catch, with zero further errors downstream. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (SECURITY_D genuinely reads WIZLIST at boot, confirmed via source). Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: BIG5/GB prompt -> English id -> y/n create-confirm -> password + confirm -> Chinese name -> character-type selection (1-5) -> gender (m/f) -> enters world with a working score/look and no lingering runtime errors. Admin permission directly confirmed via '您目前的权限是：(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 6905 .lpc files (6829 written, 44 errors on messy legacy code, 32 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates. All 3 map.lpc files confirmed content-identical (whitespace-only) to their pre-format blobs. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin), no restore errors beyond the two already-caught/documented ones.
